brandLock: Approved masters are read-only. Only deterministic resized WebP derivatives are produced.

homepageLowerLifestyle.usage: Legacy audit record only. Removed from homepage runtime because the embedded packaging is obsolete or visually altered.

homepageNewsletterEnvironment.usage: Product-free whole-and-half coconut still-life for the locked newsletter environment; generated visual contains no packaging, logo, or copy.

homepageRoutineEnvironments.usage: Product-free city-specific routine environments. Approved product cutouts are composed as independent DOM layers.

homepageOutsideShelfEnvironments.usage: Product-free approved environments for the cinematic Outside the Shelf carousel; no packaging is baked into the scenes.

heroCoconut.usage: Homepage hero only; preserve orientation, proportions, fibres, colour, and alpha edges.

heroCoconutShadow.usage: Procedural contact and ambient shadow beneath the approved coconut; independent DOM layers.

mobile.composition: Sharp approved 16:9 frame retained over a blurred and darkened enlargement of the same frame; no generated filler.

homepageScrapingVideo.usage: Pinned homepage hero-to-origin scroll-scrub transition; muted, inline and controls-free.

homepageFarmVideo.usage: Second and final homepage video, shared by sustainability and the environmental newsletter transition.

homepageOriginEnvironment.usage: Approved Pollachi coconut-grove opening state shared by the final scraping-film hold and Gate 5.

homepageHarvestEnvironment.usage: Approved coconut-origin harvest layer within the Gate 5 scroll journey.

homepageCraftEnvironment.usage: Approved lower-impact processing layer within the Gate 5 scroll journey.

homepageEverydayEnvironment.usage: Packaging-free warm kitchen environment completing the Gate 5 everyday-living transition.

water.usage: Canonical transparent Coconut Water packshot; homepage hero product shelf and approved product-only surfaces.
